reason: A read-side monitoring and telemetry integration that converts DeepSeek Harness session activity to OCSF records, stores it locally, and optionally forwards it to Splunk or OTLP collectors without modifying session events.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 会话活动规范化为 OCSF 记录，写入本地队列并可选转发到 Splunk 或 OTLP 收集器。
summaries.en: Normalizes DeepSeek Harness session activity into OCSF records, stores them in a local spool, and optionally forwards them to Splunk or OTLP collectors.

capabilities: Writes telemetry to a local spool file
Optionally sends records to Splunk HEC or an OTLP/HTTP collector
Uses keyed digests and value classifications to reduce raw-value exposure
Correlates tool calls and approval events and emits heartbeat records
